hero.subheadline: Transforming healthcare access through innovative digital solutions. Our JKN Registration and Service System makes healthcare faster, easier, and more efficient for millions of Indonesian citizens.

about.title: Revolutionizing Healthcare Access in Indonesia
about.p1: We are proud participants of Healthkathon 2025, organized by BPJS Kesehatan Indonesia. Our team is competing in the Innovation System category with a groundbreaking solution for JKN Registration and Service systems.
about.p2: Our innovation focuses on eliminating inefficiencies in the current healthcare registration process. By leveraging cutting-edge digital technology, we aim to reduce registration time by 90%, integrate national health data seamlessly, and provide real-time service tracking for all JKN participants.
about.missionText: Make healthcare registration instant and accessible for all Indonesians
about.impactText: Serving millions with efficient, queue-free digital healthcare services

features.title: Powerful Features for Modern Healthcare
features.subtitle: Our innovative platform combines cutting-edge technology with user-friendly design to deliver exceptional healthcare services
features.feature1Desc: Complete your JKN registration from anywhere, anytime. No more waiting in long queues or traveling to registration offices.
features.feature2Desc: Seamlessly connect with national health databases for instant verification and comprehensive medical history access.
features.feature3Desc: Track your application status, appointments, and health services in real-time with instant notifications and updates.
features.feature4Desc: Say goodbye to waiting rooms. Our intelligent system manages appointments and services digitally for maximum efficiency.
features.trusted: Trusted by over 1 million active users with 99% satisfaction rate
